responsibility: Implements the machine-description support for Arm synchronization and atomic operations. It defines memory barriers, acquire/release loads and stores, exclusive load/store primitives, atomic compare-and-swap and fetch-op expanders, and the split patterns that lower generic atomic RTL onto ldrex/strex, ldaex/stlex, ldrd/ldrexd, and barrier instructions according to mode, memory model, and target architectural capabilities.
